title: How this video was made
summary: How these videos are made: a lesson is data, X_eTaL computes the schedule and every frame's animation at once, and the numbers on screen are the video's own.

scenes.heading: How this video was made
scenes.narration: This video was made by the array language it is about. There is no timeline editor and no keyframes, only data and arrays.
lines: A video about X_eTaL, scheduled by X_eTaL.
No timeline editor. No keyframes. Data and arrays.

scenes.heading: 1. A lesson is data
scenes.narration: First, a lesson is data. Each scene is a heading, a few lines, and a length in seconds. The whole video is one file.
lines: Each scene is a heading, some lines and a length in seconds:
The whole video is one file: lessons/making-of/lesson.json

scenes.heading: 2. X_eTaL computes the schedule
scenes.narration: Next, the language computes the schedule. Seconds become frames, and where each scene starts is one running sum. The bar below is that array, drawn.
lines: Seconds become frames. Where each scene starts is one running sum.
The bar below is that array, drawn.

scenes.heading: 3. Every frame knows its place
scenes.narration: So every frame knows its place. For each frame, we get its scene, how far into the scene it is, and its {progress|progress}. Every frame is computed at once, as arrays.
lines: These numbers are live: this is frame {{f}} of {{total}}.
All {{total}} frames are computed at once, as arrays.

scenes.heading: 4. Motion is arithmetic
scenes.narration: Motion is just arithmetic. Each line fades in from one column of a table. And three easing curves move across this scene.
lines: Each line's fade-in is a column of that table.
Three curves over this scene: linear, in-out cubic, out cubic.

scenes.heading: 5. Frames, then a file
scenes.narration: Then a renderer draws one picture for each frame, from those numbers. It computes no timing of its own.
lines: A renderer draws one picture per frame from those numbers.
Draft: ImageMagick and ffmpeg. Final: Remotion, in React.

scenes.heading: Next
scenes.narration: Now the narration sets the length of each scene. And every lesson comes in landscape and portrait, from the same file.
lines: Lessons from the live demos: Life, Mandelbrot, N-body.
Every lesson in landscape and portrait, from one file.
